title: Community Safety and Well-Being Advisory Committee - June 18, 2025
meeting_location: Champlain Room, 110 Laurier Avenue West, and by electronic participation
present_attendees: Abid Jan (on behalf of Eric Stubbs)

agenda_items.title: Notices and meeting information for meeting participants and the public
agenda_items.description:
Members of Committee and Council, City staff, media and the general public may join the meeting with this link:
Zoom webinar ID: 840 7882 8846
Those who require a telephone number to call into the Zoom meeting may contact the committee coordinator.
Notices and meeting information are attached to the agenda and minutes, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and remote participation details.
Accessible formats and communication supports are available, upon request.
The deadline to register to speak by phone or email, or submit written comments or visual presentations is 2 pm on the day of the meeting. Note that Committee Members have expressed interest in receiving written submissions as early as possible, and at least 48 hours in advance of the meeting to allow time to review prior to the meeting.
City Hall is closed after 5 pm. Members of the public who wish to join the meeting in person after this time are asked to use the intercom at either of the main entrances of the main City Hall building (Laurier Avenue West or Lisgar Street entrances) to request access.

sub_agendas_items.title: Chair and Vice-Chair Remarks
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
At the outset of the meeting, Vice-Chair Claire Kendall recognized the contributions of Chair Tom D'Amico and thanked him for his work on the Committee, as he will be retiring and stepping down from his Committee role on June 30, 2025.
The Chair also recognized the two new public members, Mason Flatla and John Strickland, and welcomed them to the Committee.

agenda_items.title: Declarations of Interest
agenda_items.minutes: No Declarations of Interest were filed.
